poolSupportPolicy: Ordinary reels use entry-wide empirical vectors/transitions and joint multipliers; rules and configured bounds decide eligible payouts, not the smallest observed win. Feature sample extrema are descriptive, not minimum prize rules.
notes: Aggregated three-symbol reel-vector and adjacent-reel transition counts only. No full boards, original responses, or complete rounds are embedded. All paid starts and feature steps are newly sampled and independently judged. The final 100 original complete rounds are not used in parameter estimation.
